claims.claim: Used 3 Seaters and 2 Seaters Couch going for giveaway price
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only a black tufted 2-seater sofa; no 3-seater is shown.
No receipt/warranty/date proof shown; photos do not confirm purchase date.
Photos show general upholstery but do not provide close-up inspection of stains/marks.
No clear tears are visible in the provided angles, but seams/undersides are not shown.
Photos show slight wrinkling/creases on the seat cushion, but firmness/“bounce back” is not testable from images.

risks.risk: Cushion sagging or weak foam (photos can’t confirm firmness; slight creasing may indicate wear).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the seller pressing down firmly on the seat cushion and releasing to show bounce-back, plus a side view of cushion thickness after pressing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/possibly soft foam (worst-case comfort/structure), not as “firm.”

risks.risk: Hidden stains, discoloration, or odor (no close-ups; smoke-free claim can’t be verified remotely).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all upholstery seams and the entire seat/back surface under bright light, plus a quick sniff/odor check video (seller opens/stands near the sofa and demonstrates no odor).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially stained/odor-affected upholstery until close-ups confirm otherwise.

risks.risk: Frame wobble/loose joints or unstable gold legs (not testable from still photos).
risks.proof: Video clip showing the sofa being gently rocked from both ends and each leg checked for wobble; also a view of leg attachment points.

risks.risk: Material type and durability (velvet/fabric/leather look-alike affects cleaning and longevity; photos don’t confirm).
risks.proof: Photo of upholstery label/tag (if any) or close-up of fabric texture and seam construction; include underside/back panel showing material.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic fabric upholstery with higher cleaning risk.

risks.risk: Not actually a true 2-seater (could be wider/marketed incorrectly).
risks.proof: One shot with a measuring tape across the sofa width and seat width (or a tape measure against the frame) to confirm it’s truly 2-seater sized.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain sizing (worst-case: not clearly a standard 2-seater).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the entire seat, backrest, and arm seams (front + both sides) under bright light to check stains/tears.
Send a short video pressing the seat cushion hard and releasing to demonstrate foam firmness/bounce-back.
Send a video rocking the sofa gently from both ends to show frame stability and leg tightness.
Send a photo of any upholstery tag/label or underside/back panel showing material type.
Send a measuring-tape shot for overall width and seat width to confirm it’s truly a 2-seater.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type as a black tufted 2-seater sofa with gold-colored legs, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. Seller claims about age, stains, foam firmness, and smoke-free origin are not verifiable from photos, so the price should assume potential wear until the requested proof is provided.
